units.title: Welcome to School
units.description: Understanding that school is a place for learning and making friends.
steps: Name your favorite place in the school.
Identify the people who help you learn (teachers).
Recognize that school is a community.

units.title: Helping Each Other
units.description: Learning about teamwork and kindness in school.
steps: Identify how the librarian or the helper makes school better.
Realize that every person in school is important.
